subject: PR Checks' Pre-commit Hooks job fails on main because detect-secrets flags the landing sha in every cards/closed/*.json archive
activeForm: Teaching the CI detect-secrets step that card archives carry commit shas

work_items: PR Checks' Pre-commit Hooks job fails on main because detect-secrets flags the landing sha in every cards/closed/*.json archive

description: Found by card #17 on 2026-10-14. PR Checks run 38453036791 on main 8bd2a8ac fails the 'Detect secrets (non-mutating, blocking)' step: Hex High Entropy String at cards/closed/8.json:5, 10.json:5, 12.json:5, 13.json:5 and 16.json:5. Line 5 of each archive is the 40-hex landing sha that Hydrostat's DONE close writes (the archive format is in ~/dotfiles/docs/hydrostat.md, 'The archive'). Every future DONE close adds one more finding, so the step stays red. The job is not a required status check on main, so it blocks no merge. The step scans git ls-files minus tests/ and .secrets.baseline (.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml:326). Fix options are excluding cards/closed/ from that file list or adding the archives to .secrets.baseline; exclusion is the one that does not need a baseline edit on every close. Whether dotfiles' own CI hits the same thing is unmeasured.
